Settings of a Built-in Theme

Source: R/theme.R
geneviewer_theme.Rd

Returns the settings of a built-in theme of GC_theme(), to see them or to start a theme of your own.

Usage

geneviewer_theme(name = "default")

Arguments

name

Name of the theme: "default", "classic", "dark", "vintage", "infographic", "publication" or "bw".

Value

A list of theme settings, to use as the theme of GC_theme().

Examples

geneviewer_theme("dark")
